title: The whole-open resolution class is the cocycle Leray edge
statement: Let f:X→Y be a scheme morphism, F an O_X-module, I an injective resolution of F, and n a natural number. Let K=f_*I be its direct-image complex. The whole-open resolutionSectionClass I K at degree n [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices], followed by the inverse of I.isoRightDerivedObj(f_*,n) evaluated at the top open, is the chosen Leray edge in [lem-pc-leray-degenerate-sections]. This statement concerns only the whole-open class, with no restricted resolution or variable open.

proof.text: Apply section_comparison_cycles: evaluation of the theta map on a cycle class equals the quotient of the corresponding section of the cycle sheaf, specified using the inverse kernel comparison.

The forgetful homology comparison respects the cycle quotient. Evaluation preserves the cycle inclusion, so the section of the cycle sheaf specified by its image in the degree term is unique. It is therefore the z in the chosen Leray edge cocycle characterization. Apply the preceding calculation to this cycle.

The homology projection is surjective and the right-derived resolution comparison is invertible. Represent any cohomology class by a cycle, apply the cocycle equation, and conclude equality of additive homomorphisms. Degree zero and empty schemes obey exactly the same argument.

lean.statement:
theorem whole_open_leray_edge {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (F : X.Modules) (I : InjectiveResolution F) (n : ℕ) :
    let := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor_additive X.toRingedSpace
    let K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf) ℕ :=
      ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex
    resolutionSectionClass I K ⊤ (Iso.refl _) n ≫
      Hom.app (I.isoRightDerivedObj (pushforward f) n).inv ⊤ =
    ((Classical.choose (exists_lerayEdge_isIso_of_vanishing f)) n).app F
